headline: Last night's three stock orders are in and resting for the open; the open risks are three option structures to close, one of them new: APLAPOLLO is in the F&O ban.

points.label: Signals
points.text: The three signals from last night (TORNTPHARM entry x4, ASHOKLEY add-on x13, POWERINDIA add-on x1) were placed as after-market orders and are resting at the open; nothing new today. The independent cross-check still says ASHOKLEY's Supertrend is RED on complete data while the backtester says green: advisory only, but it is the order to watch.

points.label: Options process
points.text: The GTT scan shows 0 findings across 69 contracts. CUMMINSIND 5000CE has decayed 71% (past the 60% target) and the buy-back is queued at 6.30; its old trailing stop (50) must be cancelled once the buy-back fills, or it would buy a new long. APLAPOLLO 1920CE is a new exit signal: the stock entered the NSE F&O ban, so the call cannot be rolled or replaced.

points.label: Risk
points.text: NATIONALUM (-Rs10.3k) and NMDC (-Rs1.9k) put spreads are against a red colour and still open; the NATIONALUM loss grew overnight. Financial Services is still 51% of deployed swing capital against a 40% limit. If every position closed on its Supertrend line the book would be about -Rs53k, so a bad open is survivable.

points.label: Book
points.text: Unrealised swing P&L is +Rs38.5k against realised -Rs13.7k from 5 closed trades. The Supertrend exits cost money this week while winners run; too few closed trades to judge the rule.

points.label: Versus the backtest
points.text: 5 closed trades against 20.2% CAGR, -21.3% drawdown, 41% win rate: too early to compare. Watch the first 30 closed trades.

action: Before or at the open: close the NATIONALUM and NMDC put spreads and the APLAPOLLO 1920CE; the CUMMINSIND buy-back is already queued at 6.30, so leave it. Then place nothing new: the TORNTPHARM, ASHOKLEY and POWERINDIA orders are already in.
